title: Stocks in news: Tata Motors, RVNL, Eicher Motors, Mazagon Dock and Lupin
summary: Indian equity markets experienced volatility, with the Nifty 50 extending its losing streak for four weeks. Escalating US-Iran hostilities pushed crude oil prices higher, impacting overall market sentiment. Several companies, including Tata Motors and Rail...

contentHtml:
Indian equity markets remained volatile and under pressure through the week, with the Nifty 50 extending its losing streak to four consecutive weeks — its longest run in five months — as escalating US-Iran hostilities pushed crude oil prices higher and weighed on risk sentiment.

The Nifty 50 closed at 23,897.70 on Friday, rising 0.10% after four consecutive sessions of losses. Despite the late-week recovery, the index declined around 1.2% during the week and remained below key moving averages, keeping the broader technical setup weak.

On the upside, the 24,000–24,200 range remains the immediate resistance zone. The 24,000 level is particularly important as the index has repeatedly failed to sustain gains above the psychological mark. A sustained close above 24,200 would be needed to improve the near-term structure, said Ponmudi R, CEO of Enrich Money.

Against this backdrop, shares of Tata Motors, Rail Vikas Nigam (RVNL), Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders, Eicher Motors, Lupin and several other companies are likely to remain in focus on Monday following key corporate developments.

Oil & Gas stocks

Shares of oil marketing companies (OMCs) are likely to remain in focus on Monday after the US struck three Iranian oil tankers following ballistic missile attacks by Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps on two US Navy ships.

Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders

The Navratna public sector undertaking said it has received a Rs 118 crore purchase order from Maharashtra State Electricity Transmission Company Limited (MSETCL) for the supply, installation and commissioning of an AI-based Comprehensive Infrasecure Project for five substations.

Tata Motors

Tata Motors Commercial Vehicles has launched an open offer for shares of Italian automotive company Iveco Group at €14.1 per share. According to the company, the offer values the Italian transport vehicle manufacturer at approximately €3.82 billion.

Rail Vikas Nigam (RVNL)

The Navratna public sector undertaking said on Friday, September 4, that it has received a Rs 903 crore Letter of Award from SJVN Thermal Private Limited, a wholly owned subsidiary of SJVN Limited. The award relates to work for the 1,320 MW Buxar Thermal Power Project in Bihar.

Eicher Motors

The automaker announced that Royal Enfield has launched the Himalayan 440 in India at an ex-showroom price of Rs 2.29 lakh. Bookings opened on Friday, September 4.

Seamec

The company said its vessel SEAMEC SWORDFISH, after completing planned maintenance, was on-hired with effect from September 6, 2026, at 15:43 hours (KSA).

Gujarat Narmada Valley Fertilizers and Chemicals

The Government of Gujarat, through a notification dated September 5, 2026, withdrew the nomination of Rajkumar Beniwal, IAS, as Managing Director of the company. It nominated Sanjeev Kumar, IAS, to hold additional charge as Managing Director on the company’s board. Sanjeev Kumar will be formally appointed as Managing Director at the ensuing Board of Directors meeting.

Lupin

The pharmaceutical firm said it has received US Food and Drug Administration (US FDA) approval for Modafinil Tablets USP, 100 mg and 200 mg.

Brigade Enterprises

The realty firm has launched Brigade Barcelona in Hyderabad’s Neopolis, with a revenue potential of more than Rs 2,700 crore. The project marks the company’s latest expansion in the city.

Lemon Tree Hotels

The company has signed licence agreements for two properties in Bodhgaya, Bihar, adding 145 rooms to its portfolio in the state.

Prime Focus

The company said its board has approved a plan to raise up to Rs 3,000 crore through one or more permissible modes, including equity shares, debt securities, non-convertible securities, share warrants and other equity-linked securities.

JSW Steel

The company reported a 3% year-on-year increase in consolidated crude steel production to 24.65 lakh tonnes in August 2026. Domestic operations recorded a 4% increase to 23.87 lakh tonnes, while production from its US operations declined 11%.

CIE Automotive India

The auto components maker announced that it has invested Rs 120.76 crore in its wholly owned subsidiary, CIE Hosur Limited, by acquiring 69.4 lakh fully paid-up equity shares on a rights basis.

Cohance Lifescience

The company said it received a Form 483 with four observations from the US FDA for its finished dosage form (FDF) plant in Telangana.
